Meridian Diagnostics Console

MERIDIAN_205 indicates that the remote trace collector paused due to disk quota limits.

Supported Ports

ServicePortProtocol
Trace IngestThe trace ingest listener binds to TCP port 7443 with mutual TLS.mTLS
Health ProbeHTTP readiness probe listens on port 7440.HTTP

Operator Actions

  • Drain active diagnostic sessions before rotating the console TLS bundle.
  • Verify audit stream delivery after every collector restart.

Operational note 1 for meridian-html (trace-buffers): During routine shift handoffs, operators inspect the telemetry dashboard for meridian-html across rack bay 11, verify that the ambient cooling intake stays within nominal seasonal tolerances, and confirm that weekly archive rotation completed before the midnight maintenance checklist. Capacity planning teams review rolling fourteen-day utilization charts for trace-buffers, comparing peak burst volume against provisioned headroom and noting any scheduled firmware staging windows in the regional calendar. Incident commanders keep printed escalation trees beside the console desk and record routine drill timestamps in the shared station logbook without modifying active production parameters or altering steady-state routing weights.
